title: Cylinder operator [[0, 1]] × X: conjuncts (7)–(9)
statement: Assume (VO), the vanishing-off-support antecedent: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0; (REP), the mass-representation antecedent: for U open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ (μ(Uᶜ) = 0, finite on compact subsets of U) and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n (μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α) with M_W(T) = μ(W) for every open W, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω, and, if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0; and (LB), the covector-bounds antecedent (exactly the frozen type of the parent's covector-bounds dependency): (L1) |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| for every continuous linear A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and k-covector β on ℝ^{N'}; (L2) |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β| for v ∈ ℝ^N and every (k+1)-covector β on ℝ^N; (L3) |α(τ)| ≤ |α| for orthonormal τ (exact frozen Lean types, written as antecedents). Then there are maps cyl_{N,k} : 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) (all N, k; currents on univ) such that, writing ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)), Jv := ι(0, v) and e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1: (7) for X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞, cyl(X) has compact support, M(cyl X) < ∞, M(∂ cyl X) < ∞ and spt cyl(X) ⊆ {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ spt X}; (8) cyl(X − Y) = cyl(X) − cyl(Y) for such X, Y; (9) for such X and every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is η ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all x, v and cyl(X)(ω) = X(η). These are verbatim the conjuncts (7), (8), (9) of the parent statement.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) ∧ ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → boundaryMassOn T W < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0)) → ((∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid N) k) (τ : Fin k → Euclid N), Orthonormal ℝ τ → |α τ| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∃ (cyl : ∀ (N k : ℕ), GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)), (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → IsCompact (cyl N k X).support ∧ (cyl N k X).mass < ∞ ∧ (cyl N k X).boundary.mass < ∞ ∧ (cyl N k X).support ⊆ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))}) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → IsCompact Y.support → Y.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn Y univ < ∞ → cyl N k (X - Y) = cyl N k X - cyl N k Y) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) ∧ cyl N k X ω = X η
